environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: The loop bound is one iteration for POST, so a POST whose body carries the second request line is never replayed. The upstream runs nothing on attempt 2 and the client gets 502 although the healthy peer was reachable. The healthy control returns 200, so the 502 is the missing retry rather than a harness fault.
findings.title: The retry guard excludes POST, so a body-carried exec is lost on failover and becomes a 502

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
